LanguageData.BOR_Quasar_Apparel_PowerArmorHelmet.desc:
A helmet formed from Quasar Alloy, complete with proprietary IFF (Identify Friend or Foe) software, Short-Range radio, and BallisTek armored camera arrays for maximum Field of View and protection.
Normally it would cost an arm and a leg to get a Helmet of this level, though there are times you may find it on sale for two arms and zero legs, what a steal!
